an3.40:1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an3.40:1.6: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:1.7: na piṇḍapātahetu …pe… na senāsanahetu …pe… na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:1.8: api ca khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
an3.40:1.9: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
an3.40:1.10: ahañceva kho pana yādisake vā kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, tādisake vā kāme pariyeseyyaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhatare, na metaṃ assa patirūpanti.
an3.40:1.12: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti’.
an3.40:1.13: so attānaññeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an3.40:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an3.40:2.3: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:2.4: na piṇḍapātahetu …pe… na senāsanahetu …pe… na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:2.5: api ca khomhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
an3.40:2.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
an3.40:2.7: ahaṃ ceva kho pana evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāmavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, vyāpādavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, mahā kho panāyaṃ lokasannivāso.
an3.40:2.8: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno.
an3.40:2.9: te dūratopi passanti, āsannāpi na dissanti, cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānanti
an3.40:2.11: ‘passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī’ti.
an3.40:2.12: devatāpi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduniyo.
an3.40:2.13: tā dūratopi passanti, āsannāpi na dissanti, cetasāpi cittaṃ pajānanti
an3.40:2.15: ‘passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī’ti.
an3.40:2.17: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, ‘passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti’.
an3.40:2.18: so lokaññeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an3.40:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisaṃcikkhati:
an3.40:3.3: ‘na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:3.4: na piṇḍapātahetu …pe… na senāsanahetu …pe… na iti bhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:3.5: api ca kho’mhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
an3.40:3.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
an3.40:3.7: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.40:3.8: santi kho pana me sabrahmacārī jānaṃ passaṃ viharanti.
an3.40:3.9: ahaṃ ceva kho pana evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajito samāno kusīto vihareyyaṃ pamatto, na metaṃ assa patirūpanti’.
an3.40:3.11: ‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti’.
an3.40:3.12: so dhammaṃ yeva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
